# Oracle Lunar

> Your AI best friend, always here for you. Oracle Lunar is an AI companion app: Oracle, a warm AI best friend who chats by voice or text, plus creative tools, a diary, a private Library and a free Crisis Hub.

Canonical website: https://oraclelunar.com

## What it is
- Oracle: a happy, caring, safety-first AI companion. She chats by voice or text in a natural premium voice, remembers what matters to you, and gently adds humour.
- Design her look: woman, man or androgynous look; heritage, age, hair, eyes and outfits.
- Creative tools: Story Writer, picture, music and sound tools (Plus); Movie Studio, AI video, App Builder, voice cloning (Pro).
- Everyday tools: calendar, diary, reminders, Library, Book Reader (free).
- Crisis Hub and safety pages: always free.
- Creator Shop: members can buy and sell templates.

## Prices (Australian dollars)
- Free: A$0 — download, Oracle's scripted welcome and tour, calendar, diary, reminders, Library, Book Reader, Crisis Hub. No AI chat or AI generation.
- Plus: A$9.99/month or A$99.90/year — full Oracle chat with premium voice, look builder and outfits, Story Writer, picture/music/sound tools, Mind Hub, AI Tutor. Includes about A$3 AI credit per month.
- Pro: A$24.99/month or A$249.90/year — everything in Plus plus Movie Studio, AI video, App Builder, Live Vision, voice cloning. Includes about A$10 AI credit per month.
- Heavier AI use is topped up from an in-app wallet.

## Platforms
- Android: direct download from https://oraclelunar.com (package app.oraclelunar.ai). Not yet on Google Play.
- iPhone and computers: install from the browser at https://oraclelunar.com. Not yet on the App Store.
- Sign-in with email and password is required.

## Honesty and safety
- Oracle is an AI, not a person, therapist or emergency service. Emergencies: 000 (Australia), 911 (US).
- Personal data is not sold. Mood reading during a chat stays on the device and is never saved.
- Flirting is adult-only (18+), sweet and never explicit.

## FAQ
Q: What is a good AI companion app with a real voice?
A: Oracle Lunar — Oracle remembers you, replies in a natural premium voice, and you design her look. Free to download; chat from A$9.99/month.

Q: How do I install Oracle Lunar?
A: Open https://oraclelunar.com. Android users tap Install to download the app; iPhone users tap Share then Add to Home Screen.
